title: Acceptance result
description: Result of one acceptance scenario or the fail-closed consolidation of a feature (spec 002 RF-4, RF-29). The six statuses map onto runtime/lib/result.mjs without changing that enum: PASS->PASS, FAIL->FAIL, BLOCKED/STALE/NOT_RUN->ERROR, NOT_APPLICABLE (approved or structural)->NOT_APPLICABLE. STALE, NOT_RUN and BLOCKED always block.
